exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: A foundational movement that builds leg strength and makes everyday actions like sitting and standing easier.
safety: Keep your heels on the floor and knees tracking in line with your toes.
Lower only as far as you can while keeping your back neutral.
Stop if you feel sharp pain in your knees, hips or back.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: A classic full-body warm-up that raises your heart rate and wakes up the shoulders and hips.
safety: Land softly with slightly bent knees.
For a low-impact version, step one foot out at a time instead of jumping.
Choose a non-slip surface and supportive shoes.
mistakes: Letting arms swing loosely without control

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.description: A push-up variation with knees down that builds pressing strength while you master form.
safety: Place a soft mat under your knees.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower with control; stop if your shoulders or wrists hurt.
mistakes: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.description: An isometric hold that trains your core to keep the spine steady and supported.
safety: Elbows directly under shoulders.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
Drop to your knees if your lower back starts to ache.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Strengthens the back of the body and supports healthy hips, especially after long periods of sitting.
safety: Press through your whole foot, not just the toes.
Lift until hips align with knees and shoulders — avoid over-arching.
Keep your neck relaxed on the floor.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top

exercises.name: Controlled Crunch
exercises.description: A small, controlled curl that strengthens the front of the core.
safety: Support your head lightly; don't pull on your neck.
Keep your lower back in contact with the floor.
Move slowly and exhale as you curl up.
mistakes: Yanking the head with the hands
Lifting too high off the floor

exercises.name: Cat–Cow
exercises.description: A gentle flowing movement that mobilises the whole spine in time with your breath.
safety: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Move within a comfortable range.
Use a cushion under the knees if needed.

exercises.name: Standing Side Stretch
exercises.description: Opens the sides of the body and helps you breathe more freely.
safety: Keep both feet grounded.
Reach up and over rather than collapsing sideways.
Stop at a gentle stretch, never pain.

exercises.name: Standing Forward Fold
exercises.description: A calming stretch for the back of the legs and spine.
safety: Bend your knees as much as you need.
Hinge from the hips and let the head hang.
Roll up slowly to avoid dizziness.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.description: Warms up the shoulder joints with small, controlled circles in both directions.
safety: Start with small circles and grow gradually.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Switch direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Marching in Place
exercises.description: A low-impact way to raise your heart rate — perfect for beginners and warm-ups.
safety: Stand tall and swing the opposite arm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Go at a pace where you can still talk.

exercises.name: Static Split Squat
exercises.description: A stable lunge variation that builds single-leg strength and balance.
safety: Hold a wall or chair for balance if needed.
Lower straight down; keep the front knee over the ankle.
Complete 8 reps on each side.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: Press light dumbbells or filled water bottles overhead to build shoulder strength.
safety: Choose a weight you can lift with full control.
Brace your core and avoid arching the back.
Skip this if you have a shoulder injury.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: The classic bodyweight press that strengthens the chest, arms and core together.
safety: Hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Body stays in one straight line.
Drop to knee push-ups when form breaks down.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Stepping backward makes lunges knee-friendly while training balance and leg strength.
safety: Step back far enough that both knees bend to about 90°.
Keep your chest tall.
Complete 10 reps on each leg.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: A dynamic plank that builds core stability and cardio fitness at the same time.
safety: Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Slow down to keep your hips level.
Place hands on a bench to make it easier.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: Running on the spot with knees driving high — a quick cardio burst.
safety: Land lightly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest up.
March instead of running if you need lower impact.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.description: A unilateral bridge that challenges hip stability and evens out strength between sides.
safety: Keep hips level as you lift.
Complete 10 reps on each leg.
Return to two legs if you feel cramping.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description: A rotating crunch that trains the obliques with a smooth pedalling rhythm.
safety: Rotate from the ribcage, not the elbows.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep the lower back in contact with the floor.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.description: A wide-stance squat that emphasises the inner thighs and hips.
safety: Toes turned out slightly, knees follow the toes.
Keep your torso upright.
Only go as low as your hips comfortably allow.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
exercises.description: From a high plank, tap each shoulder while resisting rotation through the hips.
safety: Widen your feet for more stability.
Move slowly so the hips stay still.
Perform from the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.description: Releases tight hips from sitting. Hold 30 seconds on each side.
safety: Pad the back knee.
Gently tuck the pelvis rather than leaning forward.
Hold a chair for balance if needed.
mistakes: Front knee travelling past the toes

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.description: An all-fours rotation that improves upper-back mobility. Alternate sides each rep.
safety: Keep hips stacked over knees.
Rotate gently and follow your hand with your eyes.
Use a cushion under knees if needed.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.description: An explosive squat that builds power. Only add this once regular squats feel easy.
safety: Land softly and sink straight into the next squat.
Use a non-slip surface.
Skip jumping if you have knee or ankle problems.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.description: Hands together under the chest shift the work onto the triceps.
safety: Keep elbows close to the body.
Maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Widen the hands if your wrists feel strained.

exercises.name: Alternating Jump Lunge
exercises.description: A powerful plyometric lunge that switches legs in the air.
safety: Master reverse lunges first.
Land softly with control.
Switch to step-back lunges when tired.
mistakes: Landing with a straight front leg

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.description: Squat, plank, return and stand — a demanding full-body conditioning move.
safety: Step back instead of jumping to reduce impact.
Keep the core braced in the plank.
Pace yourself and rest whenever you need.

exercises.name: Plank Up-Down
exercises.description: Move between forearm and high plank while keeping the hips steady.
safety: Widen the feet to reduce rocking.
Alternate the leading arm.
Perform from the knees to scale it down.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
exercises.description: Drive each knee toward the opposite elbow to add rotation to the climber.
safety: Keep shoulders stacked over wrists.
Control the knee drive rather than speeding up.
Slow down if your hips bounce.
